featured_reviews.name: Arun S P
featured_reviews.review_text: I was just walking by today. I was supposed to get to a hotel nearby but the auto had broken down. So I walked in the hot sun for more than 1.5 km. Sweating and drained of energy. When I passed by this store, I heard an announcement in a man's voice saying “free chass lelo”, “sab ke liye chaas hai”, “bohot dhoop hai, chass pee lo”. "Chaas" is the Hindi word for buttermilk. And sure enough, there was a lady serving buttermilk to everyone. I look at her with an amused smile and she immediately smiled back and said "aayiye" with a Jug full in her hand. I stopped and stepped in front of the table with two trays full of glasses being filled with buttermilk. While picking one up, I asked "Kis khushi mein?" Meaning, For what joyous occasion? She replied, "It's hot na sir. Just serving everyone". I was so surprised by their thoughtful gesture, they're simply serving because everyone needs some refreshment in this hot sun. That one glass of buttermilk brought my energy back. And just the pleasant experience left me with a huge smile throughout my walk to the hotel. Definitely 5 stars :) But for a completely surprising reason ;)
